title: Wave Physics as Representation: Tensor-Structured Neural Reconstruction for Ocean Acoustic Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.01680v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) complex ocean acoustic fields from sparse measurements is challenging due to highly oscillatory wave structures and restricted sensing patterns/routes. Learning-based approaches fall into two categories. First, purely data-driven models can learn complex field patterns, but do not explicitly exploit wave physics that may enhance interpretability and reduce training costs. Second, physics-informed methods impose a specified physical equation as a reconstruction constraint, but often require environment-dependent parameters that are difficult to acquire. As a result, practical 3D acoustic field reconstruction that is both physically grounded and robust to uncertain environmental information remains largely unexplored. This work takes an alternative route: instead of solving a fully specified wave equation, it extracts a structured representation from wave physics and learns its components fro

translated_title: 波动物理作为表示：用于海洋声场的张量结构神经重建
translated_abstract: 从稀疏测量中重建三维（3D）复杂海洋声场极具挑战性，原因在于高度振荡的波结构以及受限的感知模式与路径。基于学习的方法可分为两类：第一类是纯数据驱动模型，虽然能够学习复杂的场模式，但并未显式利用波动物理，而波动物理本可增强可解释性并降低训练成本；第二类是物理信息方法，其将特定的物理方程作为重建约束，但往往依赖难以获取的环境相关参数。因此，如何在物理上有依据、又能对不确定环境信息保持鲁棒性的实用3D声场重建，在很大程度上仍是一个未被充分探索的问题。本工作采取了另一条路线：不再求解完全指定的波动方程，而是从波动物理中提取一种结构化表示，并学习其各个组成部分……
tldr: 该论文提出从波动物理中提取结构化表示并用张量结构神经网络学习其组件的新路线，实现了既具物理可解释性、又对不确定环境信息鲁棒的海洋三维声场稀疏重建。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an alternative route that extracts a structured representation from wave physics and learns its components via tensor-structured neural networks, enabling physically grounded and robust 3D ocean acoustic field reconstruction from sparse measurements.
